name: Darkness Boyfriend
original_name: ダークネス・ボーイフレンド
source:
One day early in the morning-

I was confessed to by a male friend in my class, Tsuyuki Shione.

I was confused by the sudden confession, and I've choked on words.

At that time, I noticed a suspicious figure watching us from behind the school building.

When I saw it, I immediately gave him a reply to my confession.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/3040]NovelGame[/url]]
